name: Villarrica (Colombia)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green, the white narrower and charged with the municipal arms of Villarrica.
history: Municipal flag of Villarrica, a municipality in the department of Tolima, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Villarrica arms — oval with a sun, mountains and bananas
